names.0: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
names.1: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
names.2: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.
names.3: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
names.4: Pick up the coin from the holder and insert it precisely into the coin bank.
names.5: Arrange the letters to spell "RoboDojo" in a row.
names.6: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
names.7: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
names.8: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.
names.10: Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.
names.11: Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
names.12: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.
names.13: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.
names.14: Wait for the opponent to discard a tile, then declare a kong with the matching tiles.
names.15: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
names.16: Remember the first object on the conveyor, then pick the matching object when it appears again.
names.17: Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on the stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.
names.18: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
names.19: Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.
names.20: Place all stacking toy pieces onto the correct pegs.
names.21: Play tic-tac-toe as the first player and fill the board with the opponent.
names.22: Plug the charger into the power strip.
names.23: Pour all the balls from the cup into the vase.
names.24: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.
names.25: Press the two red buttons the required number of times according to the number cards, then press the blue button to confirm.
names.26: Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.
names.27: Pick up the bottles and throw them into the dustbin, using handover when needed.
names.28: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
names.29: Stack the three blocks with different textures.
names.31: Hang the headphones on the headphone stand, close the laptop, then place it into the vertical laptop stand.
names.32: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.
names.33: Swap the two blocks using the empty mat, pressing the button after each move.
names.34: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
